title: Finite Q3 cube support-local versus full-volume energy-weight stress test
question: In the exact finite Q3 cube, does a support-local energy weight for one bond produce a different and finite two-sided mixed force-momentum estimate from the full-volume shifted-H weight, and what does the volume comparison establish?

model.graph: Q3 cube vertices {0,1}^3 with Hamming-distance-one edges; target edge is vertices 0 and 1

adversarial_review.check: The eight-site volume is the exact Q3 cube graph; the two-site row is the target edge subsystem, not an arbitrary 1D proxy.
H_X is embedded into the full tensor product before spectral powers; no tensor-factor commutation is assumed in the factorization.
rho is generated by the full-volume H_Lambda for both weights, so local-weight rows do not use a local Gibbs state substitution.
The residual R_L is retained for every volume and both weights; the residual-free coordinate identity is not claimed.
Volumes 2 and 8 at oscillator dimension two are a finite stress test only; no volume-uniform limit follows.
The independent lane rebuilds the tensor-product cube, local/full weights and Gibbs state without importing the primary lane.
R265 checks only the rational corrected-bound algebra and local/full scope labels, not finite spectral calculus or thermodynamic QFT.
Projected D/delta-D Cauchy, critical topology, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: A finite exact Q3 cube comparison of support-local and full-volume energy weights for the corrected mixed estimate, with both weights evaluated in the same full-volume Gibbs state.
qft_interface.open: A local source/volume/cutoff-uniform graph estimate, exact CCR/modular domain transfer, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, all-bond critical topology, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite Q3 cube volume stress test. It is diagnostic evidence for the local-weight gate, not a volume-uniform theorem or a QFT/Clay result.
next_action: Use the finite comparison only to choose the declared local weight; then prove the all-bond two-orientation recurrence and direct projected D,delta-D Cauchy on the common Q3 core, or record a scaling obstruction if the local constants fail.
no_overclaim: This package is not a local-weight uniformity theorem, an all-bond critical graph theorem, an ideal residual-free Q3 core theorem, an all-time projected D/delta-D theorem, an OS reconstruction, a KMS/GNS result, a mass-gap proof, a continuum result, a C6/Sector-A/Pre-A result, a TECT production map or a Clay result.
